title: In 1984, Lou Dobbs acquired a New Jersey farm and expanded it over four decades
summary_full: Lou Dobbs is parting with his stunning 283-acre estate, Hickory Hollow, now available for $6 million. This sprawling property, crafted over 40 years, boasts an impressive 11-acre pond alongside equestrian amenities. The main colonial-style residence, complemented by guest accommodations, reflects the late television personality's vision. With vast expanses, this land holds promise for both residential development and agricultural endeavors.
